science_question: Certify exactly what the original frozen matched neutrino distributions determine about a causal, force-free kinetic transport factor on the E16 two-leg triangles; explicitly decide whether original CLASS linear transfer and this factor identify any retarded halo/tracer long-short response. They do not without a specified physical forcing/background halo and tracer model.

derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.background: Homogeneous isotropic frozen E8 f_FD,f_plus,f_minus as functions of ORIGINAL q_dimensionless at z_math_midpoint=0.95; free collisionless propagation BETWEEN external perturbations with no evolving halo potential in propagator; leading non-relativistic q-dependent streaming velocity only. No source re-fitting.
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.mode_equation: For a fixed external epoch with v(q)=v_0*q: [partial_eta + i(k dot v)] delta_f=0 between impulses, solution exp[-i k dot v (eta-eta_prime)] delta_f(eta_prime). This is the retarded homogeneous propagator with theta(eta-eta_prime); it is not the force/source term and not the self-consistent Einstein-Vlasov solution.
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.angular_characteristic: C_F(s)= integral_qmin^qmax dq q^2 f_F(q) sinc(s q) / integral_qmin^qmax dq q^2 f_F(q); sinc(x)=sin(x)/x; s=k*v_0*(eta-eta_prime), with signed free-flight displacement along Fourier mode in ORIGINAL comoving units. For E16 actual short legs, s_i=s0*|k_i|/0.05 h/Mpc. This is an intentionally dimensionless propagator diagnostic, NOT a chosen physical lookback time, halo potential, forcing spectrum or z evolution.
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.q_integration: Original complete 4000q CSV sampled support only, composite trapezoidal integration, no q extrapolation, no arbitrary F renormalization outside normalized C ratio. Record truncated q range and unnormalized I_F(s).
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.nonrel_limit: Restricted non-relativistic fixed-epoch homogeneous streaming check; relativistic epsilon(q,a), actual conformal-time background, gravitational source, self-gravity, finite-K mode coupling, halo potential history and LRG/ELG response NOT calculated.
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.squeezed_limit: At fixed s0, |k1| and |k2| -> k as K/k ->0, so C_F(s1),C_F(s2) -> C_F(s0*k/0.05). This does not imply the galaxy bispectrum squeezed limit.
derived_restricted_kinetic_problem.moment_scope: Original stress-energy matching at z_match=1100 does not imply equality of every number-weighted free-flight characteristic at later times. Report differences as source-only propagation diagnostics, not a measured wake.
